attempted_claim: Let U be a connected smooth affine log Calabi-Yau threefold over C with snc compactification (X,D), D=X\U, satisfying: a projective dlt log Calabi-Yau minimal model exists; (X,D) has log Kodaira dimension 0 with K_X+D a sum over D; the essential boundary contains a 0-stratum and is almost-minimal and connected in the sense of Gross-Siebert Assumption 1.1; and D supports a nef divisor with all coefficients >0. With Sk(U) the essential skeleton, let f^an_x be the Keel-Yu non-archimedean wall-crossing function from infinitesimal cylinder counts and f^log_x the Gross-Siebert logarithmic wall-crossing function exp(sum k_tau W_tau t^A z^{-u_tau}) from punctured wall-type invariants. Prove f^an_x=f^log_x at every x in Sk(U) off the singular locus, i.e. Wall^an_A=Wall^log_A for every curve class A, so the two scattering diagrams and the two mirror algebras coincide, with no dense-torus hypothesis on U.
decisive_failure: The investigation attempted three concrete routes (direct moduli comparison, toric-local-model reduction via the dlt MMP and 0-stratum, consistency-uniqueness propagation) plus a bounded focus-focus monodromy computation in output/artifacts/monodromy_check.py. All routes terminate at the same structural gap: a torus-free Berkovich-versus-punctured comparison isomorphism, which is a standalone research programme beyond a single-lane bounded effort. No part of the target was established and no emergent finding is claimed.
